fn normalize_bone_name(name: &str) -> String {
    name.rsplit([':', '|'])
        .next()
        .unwrap_or(name)
        .chars()
        .flat_map(char::to_lowercase)
        .filter(|character| character.is_alphanumeric() || !character.is_ascii())
        .collect()
}
